title: In a muted channel, a new message does not count and does not move the row
why: A muted conversation counts only messages before the mute (rw_inbox_muted_prefix_v2: seq < mute_from_seq). Decided (Tenny, #14988 review): follow the server (RisingWave). It does not move the row either: RisingWave keeps the row at its last message before the mute (rw_inbox_muted_prefix_v2's latest_seq, shown by rw_inbox_serving_v9), so the row keeps its position and preview (Tenny, #triage:#244, 2026-11-16; position case muted_message_leaves_row).
